## Hypothesis

What user, task and recurring problem are being tested?

## Evidence and authorization

Source links; participant consent; bounded data/permissions; permitted distribution route.

## Smallest experiment

Steps and owner; time/spending cap; no external outreach or purchases without authorization.

## Measurement

Metric, denominator, dates and success/stop rule established before observing the result.

## Result

Actual numbers; limitations; evidence link; decision and next action.
